name: smolvm v1.29.1
body:
## What's Changed
* Keep host directory mounts in checkpoints on request and always when pausing by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1793
* Sweep partial downloads abandoned for a day that no pull holds, at most hourly from the pull path, so cancelled pulls no longer leave partial blobs on a node forever. by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1794
* Retry image pulls cut off by a dropped connection by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1798
* Let a branch set labels on its child by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1799
* Record machine lifecycle events in a local usage journal by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1780
* Extract a zstd-compressed agent rootfs without a zstd program by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1801
* Unpack image layers with GNU tar so symlinks keep their owners by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1805
* Count a macOS process's CPU time in nanoseconds instead of mach ticks by @AlixANNERAUD in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1807
* Stop `machine run -i` spinning forever on macOS when stdin is /dev/null by @RitikaxG in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1804
* Record symlink owners on their parent directory in Linux host-extracted layers by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1809
* Pin libkrun at the hinted free page zeroing fix, so a machine's later checkpoints, restores and branches skip memory the guest freed (2.4 GB to 0.26 GB in one test). by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1800
* Pin libkrun at the symlink owner record, so .smolmachine symlinks keep their image owners on Linux hosts by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1810
* Let a checkpoint capture reply once the artifact is held on the node and upload it later through POST /checkpoints/{key}/upload, so a caller no longer waits on a multi-gigabyte upload it does not need. by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1795
* Add serve --guest-rollout-port by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1811
* Mount the image seed behind every attached disk so exporting an image machine works when VMs run under their own uid by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1812
* Mirror the pod netns gateway neighbor and route state into the guest by @quantike in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1781
* Keep the local API socket private before publishing it by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1709
* Avoid UID registry warnings when deleting unassigned VMs by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1708
* Resolve guest hostnames in image VMs and restored clones by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1705
* Preserve source VM CPU and memory when creating a pack by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1693
* Let non-root image users write to fresh workspaces by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1688
* Skip unused packed-layer device for VM-mode machines by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1678
* Preserve installed agent rootfs when relocating machine state by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1667
* Test the DNS allow-list helper against a fixed resolver, not the host's by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1665
* Fail a boot for lack of progress, not for being slow by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1788
* Make file operations target the filesystem exec uses and give each image run its own overlay by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1564
* Hash a published cache disk while it uploads instead of before by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1814
* Pin libkrun at the macOS symlink xattr fix, rebuild every bundled libkrun, and test packed symlinks by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1817
* Bump smolvm to 1.29.0 on main by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1818
* Read a chain with sixteen threads when flattening it for a publish by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1823
* Boot packed and cached runs on macOS in a fresh _boot-vm process so a registry pull no longer crashes the VM by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1821
* Show a running machine's CPU and memory usage with machine stats by @AlixANNERAUD in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1808
* Accept a local archive, stdin or rootfs directory on pack create --image by @NickyHeC in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1797
* Restamp skill packets on v1.29.0 and remove duplicated docs by @NickyHeC in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1822
* Prepare SmolVM v1.29.1 for release by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1824

## New Contributors
* @RitikaxG made their first contribution in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1804
* @quantike made their first contribution in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1781

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/compare/v1.28.1...v1.29.1
